title: 真题演练 · 连词与状语从句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 连词与状语从句。

questions.q: He was ill, ___ he didn't go to school.
questions.analysis: 生病导致没上学,表结果用 so。

questions.q: ___ it rained heavily, they went on working.
questions.analysis: 尽管下大雨仍继续工作,表让步用 although。

questions.q: I like apples, ___ my sister likes bananas.
questions.analysis: 喜好相反,表转折用 but。

questions.q: He didn't come to class ___ he was ill.
Work hard, ___ you will fail the exam.
questions.analysis: "否则"用 or,祈使句 + or 表警告。

questions.q: 判断对错:Because he was ill, so he didn't come.
questions.analysis: 应改为:Because he was ill, he didn't come.。because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子里。
